qsm-index build.description: Build the map of the git repository holding a path in the foreground: refresh its structural dependency graph, run one semantic search, and record the result in its status file

args.name: path
args.description: the local path to index

qsm-index search.description: Semantic and keyword lookup over the git repository holding an absolute path, with a natural-language or code query

args.name: path
args.description: absolute path inside the repository

args.name: query
args.description: natural-language or code query

args.name: top_k
args.description: result count, at most 20 (default 5)

qsm-index structure.description: Structural graph lookup over the git repository holding an absolute path: explain describes one node and its neighbours, path finds the shortest dependency path between two nodes

args.name: repo
args.description: absolute path inside the graphed repository

args.name: op
args.description: graph operation

args.name: node
args.description: node to explain, or the start node of a path

args.name: to
args.description: end node, for op=path only

qsm-index impact.description: What depends on a node of the structural graph of the git repository holding an absolute path, found by a reverse walk to a depth (default 2); a node nothing depends on answers unknown, never safe

args.name: repo
args.description: absolute path inside the graphed repository

args.name: node
args.description: node to find the dependents of

args.name: depth
args.description: reverse traversal depth (default 2)

qsm-index context.description: The symbols of one file of the structural graph with their start lines; with file:line it marks the enclosing symbol and adds the chunks semble finds related to that line

args.name: repo
args.description: absolute path inside the graphed repository

args.name: target
args.description: file, or file:line, relative to the repository or absolute

qsm-index reindex.description: Start a background build of the git repository holding an absolute path and return at once; a build already running is left running; --if-indexed starts one only for a repository that has an index the person did not decline

args.name: path
args.description: absolute path inside the repository

args.name: ifIndexed
args.description: start the build only when the repository already has an index and the person did not decline it; otherwise answer ok and start nothing

qsm-index edited.description: Count one edited file towards the refresh of the indexed repository holding it, and start a background build at the twentieth distinct file since the last build started; a file outside an indexed, not declined repository counts nothing

args.name: path
args.description: the edited file, absolute or relative to --cwd

args.name: cwd
args.description: the directory a relative path is resolved against (default: the working directory)

qsm-index status.description: Report whether the repository's index is present, how far it is behind HEAD, how many files changed since the build, whether a build is running, and how the last one ended

args.name: path
args.description: absolute path inside the repository

qsm-index auto.description: The session-start decision for the git repository holding a path: leave a fresh, running or declined one alone, refresh a stale one of at most 5000 files in the background, and answer ask for one with no index or a stale one above 5000 files, its data carrying askText, the instruction the session hands the agent

args.name: path
args.description: absolute path inside the repository

args.name: consent
args.description: the person's answer to ask: yes builds, no is remembered for this repository

qsm-index doctor.description: Report healthy only when the qsm-index binary is on PATH and answers --help; graphify must be 0.8.34 or newer; semble is reported beside the verdict

qsm-index mcp serve.description: Serve search, structure, reindex and status over MCP on stdio until the client disconnects; no call blocks past the 30 s MCP limit
